name: 38119 · Memphis, TN
findings: ZIP 38119 (Memphis) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38119 (Memphis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 38119 (Memphis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
